notes.title: - Official Demo Release -
notes.notes:
Ayo Pizza Enthusiasts 

Today i am pushing the biggest update to Slice & Dice we have made thus far. 

The Demo is pretty much in its final state, minus a few voice lines & other minor non-essential things. 


New Features:

4 new enemy types

Updated UI's 

DUAL WIELDING WEAPONS

Health Inspector AI (Insphector)

Balloon animal pets 

Bodies of the intruders can now be turned into hamburgers out back 

Hamburger Press inside w/ Limited amount of hamburger meat

Toppings on Both Pizza and hamburgers. 

Magazine system with OVER 15 BUYABLE ITEMS

The Health code Grading system actually effects cleanliness of the shop & how much you can charge for each item.

Fill your Squirt bottle with toilet water if you don't have enough money to pay for it

Wash off the bloody hamburgers with the toilet

Customer that needs to use the toilet

Nighttime Customers 


Progression system for surviving nights & winning mini games

8 Background songs + Voice Lines and Sound FX



Bug Fixes:

Unstuck button is now working

"Host paused the Game" text added to the UI 

Fire Extinguisher is now a 2 handed weapon 

Day and night is synched between Client and Server

Map update for Capture the Flag

Many other Small QOL updates to help optimization 





WHATS NEXT?!
-Even more enemies, weapon types, Usable items & Game modes

- Customization for cosmetics 

- Lore, Voice Lines & World Building

- Plenty of more QOL upgrades and optimization fixes




I Cannot express how much appreciation i have for all the Wishlist's, play testers and pizza patrons that are anxiously waiting this games release. The better part of this year has been making sure the game is ready for consumption, and we are getting closer and closer to the full release. So much time has passed and we are a few months behind the original release date which has made me reconsider this game needing to be released in early access and instead might have a whole new roadmap on what we plan to do after release! so thank you again for your patience and cant wait for you all to play the full release, but until then ENJOY THE DEMO!

notes.title: NEXT FEST UPDATE
notes.notes:
HUGE NEXT FEST UPDATE IS UPON US: 
 
Welcome to the Slice & Dice Pizza Shop Steam Page. 
I think you will all quickly learn that this is not your average simulator game.
You run a pizza shop by day, doing the typical job simulator actives and then as night falls you experience the tower defense aspect of Slice & Dice, fighting off hordes of angry customers, bosses & disgruntled members of a rival pizza shops. 
 Trying to keep your business afloat is the least of your problems when enemies grow in numbers each night and are trying to destroy your Pizzaria.
Make sure you save up enough money for a respawn & shiny new equipment or you'll have to start all over from Day 1 



FEATURES:
- Main "Pizza Shop Simulator" game mode (Single or Multiplayer)
- 5 other Game modes to enjoy with up to 8 friends including Basketball, Capture the Flag, Dodgeball, & more


Current Fixes:
- Multiplayer connectivity issues
- Losing ability to interact 
- Everyone can open the shop in main game mode
- Chat & other UI's are more stable 


Current Known Bugs: 
-"Key Bindings" Menu is not working 
-Mouse Sensitivity does not save when you die or reset game 
- Gamepad works for everything besides the terminal in the Pizza shop to upgrade and buy items.


Future Updates: 
- Save Game Option
-More Bosses & Enemy Variations 
- More Weapons
- Update the Capture the Flag Map 
- Additional Game Types/Maps
- A Customizable upstairs room with new items and more options to personalize your pizza shop.
- Minor Quality of Life & Gameplay Updates
- Localized into more languages



Huge thanks to everyone who is playing/downloading & Wishlisting the game.
I have huge plans to continue Development work & am really excited to keep everyone updated during this process.
if you have any questions/bug reports or comments leave them in the discussions or head over to my twitch channel! 

Happy next fest
-Soundbyte Interactive
